verdict.rationale: Featurebase's API exposes endpoints like bulk-listing all posts and a find/replace edit endpoint explicitly marketed for AI agents to make changes 'across many articles', suggesting scriptable bulk-style operations. However, there is no dedicated batch/bulk endpoint (e.g., bulk update, bulk delete, bulk status change) documented, so bulk operations would require looping single-item calls rather than a true batch API. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch endpoints (multi-id update/delete/status-change), documented rate limits or batching guidance for large-scale AI operations, independent confirmation of bulk usage at scale.
